description: Update an existing BrewPage JSON document. Requires owner token. Accepts a JSON object, array, or a JSON-encoded string. Old publications (made before 5 October 2026) are read-only: 409 OLD_PUBLICATION_READ_ONLY with createUrl to publish anew. BrewPage tokens and manage links must never be in public content.

json.description: New JSON document (object, array, or JSON-encoded string)

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

name: update_json
title: Update JSON document
